name: Logical Access Provisioning
description: Logical access to the system is provisioned based on role and least privilege principles.

name: User Access Reviews
description: User access rights are reviewed periodically to ensure appropriate access is maintained.

name: Vulnerability Management
description: Vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and remediated in a timely manner.

name: Anomaly Monitoring
description: System anomalies are monitored, logged, and investigated to prevent security incidents.

name: Change Management
description: Changes to systems and applications are authorized, tested, and documented prior to deployment.

name: Vendor Risk Management
description: Risks associated with third-party vendors are assessed and monitored on an ongoing basis.

name: Backup Restore Test
description: Backup recovery tests are performed periodically to verify data can be restored.

name: Logical Access Security
description: Security measures are implemented to protect logical access to the system.

name: End User Device Security
description: End-user devices are secured using MDM, disk encryption, and endpoint protection.

name: Physical Access
description: Physical access to sensitive facilities is restricted and monitored.

name: System Access Revocation
description: Access to systems is revoked in a timely manner when an employee departs.

name: Environmental Protections
description: Data centers have environmental controls like temperature, fire suppression, and power backups.
